patterns.name: unsigned_temp_service
patterns.condition: T1543: new or modified unsigned service executing from a temporary directory, or repeated unsigned service registrations
patterns.evidence: T1543 covers adversarial creation or modification of system services for persistence.

patterns.name: suspicious_scheduled_task
patterns.condition: T1053: unfamiliar scheduled task executing a temporary-directory program or linked to startup persistence
patterns.evidence: T1053 covers scheduled tasks used to maintain execution and persistence.

patterns.name: unrecognized_startup_entry
patterns.condition: T1543: previously unknown startup program, especially linked to another persistence mechanism
patterns.evidence: Unexpected autostart registration may indicate a persistence mechanism; require corroboration before blocking.

patterns.name: weak_persistence_indicator
patterns.condition: T1543 or T1053 low severity or isolated unverified change without a clear executable persistence chain
patterns.evidence: Single task or service changes can be administrative activity; review without automatic isolation.
